Our Story

Building Trust, One Wall at a Time

B.S Enterprises started with a simple belief — that premium interiors shouldn't be complicated to source. Today, as an authorized dealer of Polygranite India, we bring genuine, factory-backed Polygranite Sheets, UV Sheet Panels, Charcoal Panels, WPC Panels, 3D Panels and Baffle Ceilings to homes, offices and hospitality projects across the region.

Every sheet that leaves our store is checked for finish, thickness and batch quality — because "Look, Feel and Buy" only works when what you feel is exactly what you get.

  • Waterproof
  • 15-year warranty
  • Fire resistant
  • Termite proof
  • Easy installation
  • Cost effective
How It Works

From Wall to Wow — in 3 Steps

Our certified installation crew handles every panel, sheet and joint so you don't have to worry about a thing.

Step 01

Surface Preparation

Panels are secured to the wall using a specialised heat-bonding adhesive paste for a firm base layer.

Step 02

Adhesive Application

Silicone adhesive is loaded into a caulking gun and applied in careful lines roughly every 10 inches.

Step 03

Final Placement

The panel is pressed firmly into place until the adhesive bonds completely — leaving a seamless finish.
